name: Barten Pumpkins
tagline: Bumpy, large, green, tall or squatty – your favorite pumpkin grows here – Twin Cities
description: Barten Pumpkins is an agritourism farm in 716 West 280th Street, MN, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
